CHAPTER.VERS: In that day you will say, "I will give thanks to you, the ; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, the , is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation."
Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
In that day you will say, "Give thanks to the ! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!
Sing to the , for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great in the midst of you!"
